episode_title: EP. 48 Mission Possible: Your Inside Look at the 2026 CAAP Conference
question: What is the theme of the 2026 CAAP Conference and why was Mission Possible chosen?
transcript_excerpt: The theme Mission Possible came from the desire to center mission as the heart of everything the organization does. All agencies are mission-driven and work with mission-aligned organizations, so centering mission became important. The theme also aligns with constantly reminding people about how immensely capable and amazing they are.

episode_title: EP. 48 Mission Possible: Your Inside Look at the 2026 CAAP Conference
question: What are the pre-conference sessions available at the 2026 CAAP Conference?
transcript_excerpt: The pre-conference runs Monday and Tuesday and includes a hybrid weatherization day for all weatherization agencies, a two-day fiscal boot camp featuring RKL's virtual team and a community action agency speaker, the Leadership Cap second in-person meetup, an executive leadership annual meeting, and an organizational culture workshop by Brenda Reynolds on Tuesday.

episode_title: EP. 48 Mission Possible: Your Inside Look at the 2026 CAAP Conference
question: Where is the 2026 CAAP Conference being held and when does it take place?
transcript_excerpt: The 2026 CAAP Conference will be held at the Eden Resorts and Suites in Lancaster, Pennsylvania during the last week of October, running Monday through Thursday.

episode_title: EP. 48 Mission Possible: Your Inside Look at the 2026 CAAP Conference
question: How many breakout sessions are scheduled for the 2026 CAAP Conference main days?
transcript_excerpt: There are 25 breakout sessions scheduled throughout Wednesday and Thursday of the conference, featuring both community action agencies and partner speakers sharing their work and case studies.

episode_title: EP. 48 Mission Possible: Your Inside Look at the 2026 CAAP Conference
question: What is Cappy Hour at the 2026 CAAP Conference and who is sponsoring it?
transcript_excerpt: Cappy Hour is sponsored by Marsh McLennan and Key Risk Insurance and will be Halloween-themed on Tuesday night with awards for best dressed costume, funniest costume, and other categories. It has previously featured karaoke as entertainment.
